update.status: Updated SolidWorks: re-placed Carrier (the carrier), Sun, Pl (3 copies), InDog, LoDog, RangeSlv, FrontDog, ModeSlv, FDrive, FIdler and FOut in every mode; no interference between the gears in any mode, where they stand. In 4L, RangeSlv's teeth stood across LoDog's. In 4L, ModeSlv's teeth stood across FrontDog's; the gears of 4L are back at the turn they were built at. This version of SolidWorks can show a turn given in one mode in the others, so the turn may have been given in another. It worked in 4L, the configuration that was active, then showed and checked 2H, 4H and N and left the assembly in 4L. Save TransferCase_E4 in SolidWorks to keep it.

hypotheses.shared: shared by all: every configuration shows every turn and put
hypotheses.per_configuration: kept per configuration: a turn or put shows in the configuration it was made in alone
hypotheses.H: H: shared until a put is made on a body with a configuration showing, which from then keeps its own place for it; a turn or put made in a configuration not yet put in moves the shared place (every configuration not yet put in); one made in a configuration already put in moves that configuration alone
hypotheses.H_private_put: H, a put moving its own configuration alone: as H, except that a put never moves the shared place
